title: Application Development Manager (.NET / Risk Applications) - Hybrid Schedule
description:
Genesis10 is currently seeking an Application Development Manager (.NET / Risk Applications) for a 3+ month contract-to-hire position with a Regional Financial Institution located in Columbus, OH, Detroit, MI, Minnetonka, MN, and Dallas, TX.

Compensation: $70.00 - $80.00 per hour, W2, based on experience and qualifications

Position Overview:
The Sr. Service Delivery Manager for the IT CLOCS Team will manage Information Technology, including the design, development, integration, and support of applications and staff. This role supports the Corporate Communications, Enterprise Risk, and Compliance teams, helping to ensure consistency with company strategy and goals. The candidate will assist in the development of strategy, planning, funding, and delivery of technology products and services and is responsible for end-to-end technology project execution.

Primary Responsibilities:

  • Mentor and lead junior team members
  • Collaborate with other development teams for integration and deployment
  • Review complex code and modules to ensure they meet requirements, functional, and technical specifications
  • Participate and facilitate stand-ups, backlog grooming, sprint planning, task identification, estimating sessions, and sprint retrospectives.
  • Review solution architecture and design documentation
  • Define, plan, and develop services, solutions, and frameworks to provide best-fit solutions along with enterprise architecture for projects in adherence with company standards
  • Provide technical and consultative support on complex technical matters
  • Frequently work with outside vendor representatives and technical teams that interface with internal applications

Core Requirements:

  • Minimum of 5 years of People Management in an Enterprise Software environment
  • 10+ years of IT Software Development experience
  • In-depth knowledge of .NET infrastructure
  • 5+ years of coding experience in .NET Framework, .NET Core, MVC, and Entity Framework
  • 5+ years managing .NET Framework, .NET Core, MVC, and Entity Framework-based teams/applications
  • Experience developing web-based applications using HTML, JavaScript, and CSS
  • Proficient in using Microsoft SQL Server and Oracle
  • Sound knowledge of n-Tier architectures, frameworks, and design patterns
  • Familiarity with architecture styles/APIs (REST, Web Services)
  • Strong background in object-oriented development techniques

Desired Skills:

  • Prior experience with Telerik, TypeScript, and other front-end libraries like React, Angular, jQuery
  • SharePoint experience designing and developing web pages and web parts, content types, and publishing content types on site collections onthe  SharePoint platform
  • Experience with any of the following enterprise patterns/technologies/tools preferred – Zena, DataStage, GIT
  • Experience in data transformation tools - DTS/SSIS
  • Basic networking technologies, configurations, and concepts
  • Knowledge in other basic technical areas is preferred - Network, Operating System, Source Control
  • In-depth knowledge of different SDLC methodologies including Waterfall or Agile
  • Experience in the financial industry and in a Regulatory and Compliance environment preferred

  • 5+ years of experience in multiple IT areas, to include experience in at least 2 IT disciplines in a client/server or service-oriented architecture (SOA) environment, including technical architecture, network management, application development, middleware, database management or operations

title: Lead Data Engineer
description:
Genesis10 is seeking a Lead Data Engineer. This is a hybrid 3-month contract-to-hire position with a client located in Columbus, OH. Candidates can be located in Columbus, OH; Dallas, TX; Charlotte, NC; and Minneapolis, MN. 

Pay Range: $60.00 - $68.00 per hour based on experience and qualifications

Position Overview:
The Data Engineer Lead plays a pivotal role in building and operationalizing the minimally inclusive data necessary for the enterprise data and analytics initiatives, following industry standard practices and tools, as well as being interested in leading and developing current team members, while also serving as a technical leader. This position primarily leads the building, managing, and optimizing data pipelines and then moving these data pipelines effectively into production for key data and analytics consumers like business/data analysts, data scientists, or any persona that needs curated data for data and analytics use cases across the enterprise. This role will also test for data quality to ensure data conforms to business rules and is accurate, complete, consistent, and uniform.

Primary Responsibilities:

  • Architect, build, and maintain data pipelines
  • Assist with modernizing the data management infrastructure to drive automation in data integration and management
  • Partner with data science teams and business analysts to refine data requirements for analytics initiatives and data consumption needs
  • Train team members across the organization on data pipeline development and data preparation techniques to improve data integration and consumption
  • Collaborate with data governance teams to review, validate, and promote business and data science assets into the curated data catalog for governed reuse
  • Communicate complex technical concepts and results to both technical and non-technical audiences
  • Work effectively both independently and collaboratively across multiple initiatives while meeting aggressive timelines
  • Provide leadership, coaching, and mentoring to team members while fostering professional growth
  • Partner with stakeholders to ensure business requirements are clearly understood and delivered solutions meet organizational needs
  • Anticipate and evaluate emerging technology trends and assess their potential business impact
  • Coach team members through organizational and technical change while serving as a role model
  • Perform other duties as assigned


Core Requirements:

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Statistics, or a related field
  • 7+ years of experience in data management disciplines, including data integration, data modeling, data optimization, data quality, and other areas related to data engineering
  • 7+ years of experience with database programming languages and advanced analytics
  • Experience designing, building, and maintaining production ETL/ELT pipelines
  • Experience with enterprise cloud platforms, preferably AWS, Azure, or GCP
  • Demonstrated ability to communicate complex concepts and results to both technical and non-technical audiences
  • Demonstrated ability to manage multiple priorities independently and collaboratively while meeting aggressive deadlines
  • Strategic mindset with strong analytical and problem-solving skills and a focus on business outcomes
  • Professional presence with the ability to build strong cross-functional relationships
  • Ability to mentor and train junior team members
  • Proven experience leading cross-functional teams
  • Willingness and ability to learn new technologies quickly


Preferred Qualifications:

  • Master's degree in Computer Science, Statistics, or a related field
  • Hands-on experience with data testing and validation
  • Experience using data preparation tools
  • Extensive experience with data engineering technologies such as AWS Glue, Lambda, Athena, and other AWS services
  • Expert knowledge of business intelligence (BI) tools
  • Expert experience with open-source and commercial data science platforms
  • Experience working in Agile environments
  • Strong understanding of data management architectures, frameworks, and best practices
  • Proven ability to design, build, optimize, and manage scalable data pipelines
  • Experience working with large, complex, and heterogeneous datasets to build optimized data pipelines and integrated datasets
  • Demonstrated ability to extract business value from large and diverse datasets
  • Experience with DevOps practices, including version control, automated builds, testing, and release management
  • Financial services industry experience preferred

We are seeking a strategic and experienced Senior IT Business Architect to lead the alignment of banking business objectives with modern technology capabilities. This role will be pivotal in driving application modernization, digital transformation, and enterprise architecture initiatives across the bank. The ideal candidate will have deep financial services experience, strong business acumen, and a proven ability to guide legacy-to-modern transitions in a regulated environment.

title: Senior Data Integration & API Engineer - 100% Remote
description:
Genesis10 is currently seeking a Senior Data Integration & API Engineer for a Remote position with a Regional Financial Institution located in Columbus, OH. This is a 12+ month contract opportunity.

Compensation: $60.00 - $70.00 per hour, W2, based on experience and qualfications

Position Overview:
We are seeking a Senior Data Integration & API Engineer to design, develop, and maintain scalable data pipelines that extract data from APIs, ingest that data into the enterprise data lake, and transform it into structured, consumable datasets for analytics and reporting. This role sits at the intersection of integration architecture, data engineering, and analytics enablement, partnering closely with Data Engineering, Architecture, and business analytics teams to deliver high-quality, governed data assets.

Primary Responsibilities:

  • Design and develop solutions to extract data from APIs (REST/JSON, OAuth-secured APIs)
  • Build scalable ingestion pipelines to land data into the Enterprise Data Lake (landing → raw → curated layers)
  • Ensure integrations follow enterprise integration patterns (API Gateway, Event Hub, EIP)
  • Optimize ingestion patterns (batch vs near real-time)
  • Transform raw API data into curated datasets
  • Build ETL/ELT pipelines supporting data quality and schema compliance
  • Implement partitioning and performance tuning
  • Structure data for Snowflake and downstream analytics tools
  • Support Tableau dashboards and reporting needs
  • Align to enterprise data models
  • Partner with enterprise architecture teams for API onboarding
  • Ensure compliance with data and API standards
  • Develop automated pipelines and monitoring processes
  • Troubleshoot ingestion failures


Core Requirements:

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or related field
  • 5+ years experience in API integration and data engineering
  • Strong experience with REST APIs, SQL, and data pipelines
  • Experience in cloud environments (AWS preferred)


Desired Skills:

  • Experience with enterprise integration platforms
  • Familiarity with Snowflake and AWS Data Lake
  • Experience in data modeling and governance
  • Exposure to Tableau or other BI tools


Tools & Technologies:

  • Integration & API Layer: API Gateway, Event Hub, Query Hub, EIP
  • Data Pipeline & Processing: AWS (S3, Glue, Lambda), ETL frameworks
  • Data Storage & Analytics: Data Lake, Snowflake, Tableau
  • Development: Python, SQL, JSON, OpenAPI
